description: ‘Angels’ is a stunningly-realized harmony of floor-filling Soul and Gospel, both in conversation with the greats (Curtis Mayfield, SAULT, Marvin Gaye, Khruangbin) but already bearing that clear MRCY stamp; good people, coming together over quality music. Its contemplative but uplifting lyrics are likewise emblematic of MRCY’s common viewpoint, having faith that the best days lie on the other side of hard times. The band describe ‘Angels’ as “trusting that the universe will be on your side, provided you go for what you want. It’s also in part about being someone that can be counted on.”
credits:
Written by: Barney Lister, Kojo Degraft-Johnson, Jonny Lattimer
Producer: Barney Lister
Mixer: Lee Smith @ Greenmount Studios
Master: Matt Colton @ Metropolis
